dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The primary structure is a large, irregular, centrally located 'O' with a high-contrast perimeter of light-intensity pixels and a jagged edge geometry. A secondary, smaller and more circular 'O' structure is positioned posteriorly. A third, fragmented 'C' structure is visible in the anterior region near the neck. All features show a steep gradient transition from a light-pixel border to a dark-pixel core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated along the borders of the macro-annuli. Sporadic, lower-density high-intensity blobs are distributed across the lower-posterior flank area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the large central 'O', the posterior 'O', and the anterior 'C' form an obtuse triangle with its widest angle at the central centroid, oriented approximately parallel to the dorsal ridge.
